entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and I'm with VeloFit Support. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought recently. I'm thinking I might need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF77819. I received it about twelve days ago.
Okay, Sarah, I see your order right here. Before we discuss a return, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's definitely a preference thing. The device works, but I find the pulse tracking interface pretty confusing. I read through the entire user manual, but it just seems hard to use, and honestly, I expected more from the custom workout tracking.

I'm not trying to be difficult, I just don't think it's the right fit for me. Maybe there's an advanced setting I'm missing? Or perhaps some store credit would be an option if a full return isn't possible?
I understand completely. It's important that the device feels intuitive for you. Let me just pull up our return policy information here. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked your purchase date and our policy. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window, so processing a full refund won't be a problem at all.
Oh, really? That's great! I thought it might be more complicated. Ninety days is very generous.

Not a problem at all, we want our customers to be happy. I've just initiated the return on my end. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method.
Perfect, that's much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
